source_note: Support at Home program figures indexed to the Aged Care Rules 2025 as at February 2026. Figures marked 'preview' will re-verify against the July 2026 indexation event.

clinical.label: Clinical care
clinical.notes: Fully government-funded from 1 October 2026 for all classifications. Includes registered nursing, allied health, physiotherapy, occupational therapy, dietetics, podiatry.

independence.label: Independence
independence.notes: Contribution rates vary by pension status and grandfathered/no-worse-off status. See `contribution_rates.independence` below.

everyday_living.label: Everyday living
everyday_living.notes: Highest participant contribution stream. See `contribution_rates.everyday_living` below.

independence.notes: Sliding scale between 5% and 50% for part pensioners based on income and assets, indexed from Services Australia.

everyday_living.notes: Sliding scale between 17.5% and 80% for part pensioners.

care_management_note: Care management (any category) is capped at 10% of the quarterly budget. Any charge above this cap is worth raising with the provider.

carryover_rule.notes: The greater of $1,000 or 10% of the current quarterly budget rolls into the next quarter. Balances above the greater-of are forfeited at quarter end.

lifetime_cap_note: Cumulative lifetime cap on the participant's own contribution across the Independence and Everyday Living streams combined. Once reached, further participant contribution is $0 for the rest of the participant's life. Clinical care never counts towards the cap.

exit_fees.note: Exit fees are prohibited under the Aged Care Act 2024. Any exit-fee line on an invoice is a Tier-4 escalation to the ACQSC on 1800 951 822.

at_hm.label: Assistive Technology and Home Modifications scheme
at_hm.notes: Ring-fenced funding outside the quarterly budget. Access via care partner referral. Provider must be able to produce the supplier invoice for AT-HM items on request.

no_worse_off_principle.notes: Participants receiving Home Care Package care as at 12 September 2024 are protected: their Support at Home participant contribution cannot exceed what they would have paid under HCP rules. Applies for the rest of the participant's life on the program.

statement_delivery_note: Providers must issue the monthly statement within 30 days of the end of the calendar month. Statements for July, for example, must reach participants by 31 August.

trigger_events: New diagnosis (dementia, Parkinson's, stroke, cancer, mental health)
Hospital discharge with new functional needs
Home environment change (moved into or out of shared living)
reassessment.note: Reassessment can move a participant up or down a classification. If unsure, ask a My Aged Care assessor before requesting.

acqsc.name: Aged Care Quality and Safety Commission
acqsc.note: From 01/05/2026 the ACQSC has the power to order providers to refund money where overcharging is confirmed.
